name: task-manager-uat
description: Operator-only Task Manager UAT profile for end-to-end connector and local-file validation.

interface.shortDescription: Validate Task Manager safely against UAT.
interface.longDescription: Operator-only validation profile. Both the hosted MCP connector and bundled macOS local-file companion target Task Manager UAT, so fileRef upload and bind stay inside one isolated test environment. Use synthetic data only; this plugin never targets production.
defaultPrompt: List my UAT tasks and confirm the connector origin
Upload an exact local file into Task Manager UAT
Run the UAT file-first upload and bind smoke
